reason: I hunt a deal when it's easy, but settlement emails already look like spam to me, and I'm not creating an account so a startup can store my identity just to send me to a free form I have to fill out myself.
objection: I don't want a startup storing my identity details — that's the first thing I thought, and a free beta does not make it less creepy.
would_change_my_mind: If I could browse easy no-proof listings and jump straight to the official claim form with no account and no personal info collected.
